title: Saturn CG Selection Vol. 1
native_title: サターンＣＧセレクション Ｖｏｌ．１
overview:
Saturn CG Selection is a book from Sega's multimedia CD-ROM mook series, packaged with a Sega Saturn CD-ROM that showcases the computer graphics of Saturn games. The disc collects movies and still images from popular titles, letting you view each game's CG on your Saturn.

Featured games:
- Panzer Dragoon
- Riglord Saga
- World Advanced Daisenryaku
- Sega International Victory Goal
- Clockwork Knight: Pepperouchau's Adventure Part 2
- Astal
- Deadalus
- Gotha: Ismailia Seneki
